title: aster graveolens
intro: Aster graveolens, commonly known as Mexican Mountain Mint, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aster graveolens include its antispasmodic and antiseptic effects, which can help soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
